snippet.title: The Confinement | Steam, Playstation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
#QUByteConnect2025

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3327590/The_Confinement/

 The Confinement is a first-person precision platformer. Run, dodge and dash! You are trapped in Confinement, a simulation created by AmokAI. Use your sharp reflexes to overcome obstacles, escape and prove that you are the best at parkour through various levels!
